displayPattern: Washer display shows FE (also shown as E04 or E12 on some models)
meaning: Overfill error: too much water has entered the drum. The drain pump runs to prevent leaks.
causes: Extra water entering the drum, possibly through the detergent dispenser
diySteps: Check whether extra water is being supplied through the detergent dispenser
Unplug the washer, wait 60 seconds and restart it
Start a Quick 30 program; if the program does not start with a drain action, stop it and turn the washer off
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If FE, E04 or E12 persists, LG says the unit will require service.
sourceTitle: LG Front Load Washer – Error Code List (LG USA Support)
